evidence.snippet: 2. The evidence is the round's lens conversations whose coverage holds the miss's file, the verifier conversations whose claims include a lens sighting overlapping the miss's lines, every entry of each, and the round's base, head and policy commits, with the blob IDs of the lens files at the policy commit. A miss with no file and line, one the comparison marks outdated, or one on the base keeps the commits and no conversation, since no lens's coverage or sighting can be matched to it. Deciding whether a lens saw the lines, and naming the cause, is later work.

- `trust-boundary-probes`, `.melian/lenses/trust-boundary-probes/LENS.md`, extends it. It keeps its rules, instructions and budgets, and adds one line to its body, so the two lenses' conversations differ. Its `deep` level sets `probe: { prober: medium }`. The planner runs on the deep level's own tier, `heavy`, which the built-in lens sets. The prober runs on `medium`.
- The root `melian.yaml` names `lens.trust-boundary-probes` in the `full` tier, and gives it `trust-boundary`'s `paths` with `level: { floor: deep }`. So it runs its level that probes on every review that selects it, whatever triage answers.

`melian.yaml` routes `heavy` to `openai-codex/gpt-6.1-sol` and `medium` to `openai-codex/gpt-5.6-terra`, both at `thinking: low`, so the prober is the cheaper model. No tier and no route changed, and the built-in lens is unchanged, so no shipped level probes. No measurement picked this pair. It is the committed tiers, taken so that real rounds show what probing finds and costs, and [issue #356](https://github.com/melian-agent/melian/issues/356) may change it.

lowered.reason: Only a level that probes has a prober conversation, and no built-in level probes. The one such level is Melian's own `trust-boundary-probes` at deep. The planner's conversation is still kept, and so is a prober's verifier conversation when a prober finding overlaps the miss. The loss is evidence for a few misses and only in this one lens, not a trust or correctness failure.

verification.reason: Traced. At base, `stagesAt` kept every `melian.lens` stage with a conversation and coverage holding the file, which matches rule 2 of the base decision: "the round's lens conversations whose coverage holds the miss's file ... every entry of each". At head, `stagesAt` goes through `MissLines.covers`, which adds `stage.role !== "prober"`. A prober is a `melian.lens` stage and does carry `coverage` (`lensPolicy` sets it for the prober, and telemetry copies `policy.lens.coverage`). Its conversation is therefore no longer copied into `evidence/`, although the decision still requires it. The prober's verifier conversation survives only if one of its findings overlaps the miss. No head decision amends miss-evidence-is-kept. The 2026-11-22 fix-pass note says only that the prober check moved so the cause rule would not count a prober as having seen the lines. It does not mention the evidence side effect, and `evidence.test.ts` has no prober case. The cause logic and the evidence store share one predicate, so evidence for the prober was dropped without a ruling.

The ChangesetError rejection handler is documented behaviour: a round "whose commits the clone lacks, reads `no record`". No test reaches it. The ComparisonCauses tests in compare.test.ts store no telemetry, so `telemetry === undefined` short-circuits before Changeset.resolve is called. The "no record" tests at lines 1214-1285 pass through that path, and the CLI tests have no cause or firstRead coverage. If the handler rethrew every error, or the instanceof check were removed, every existing test would still pass. No guard exists, because the handler is the only code handling this case.
